text: This report recommends the appointment of four public members to the TO Live Board of Directors.

The Civic Appointments Committee referred Item CA8.1 back to the City Clerk and directed the City Clerk to: 1. Conduct additional interviews for appointment of public members to the TO Live Board of Directors and recommend candidates to the next meeting of the Civic Appointments Committee. 2. Provide a full list of all applicants who have applied to the TO Live Board of Directors at the next meeting of the Civic Appointments Committee.
